sources.title: OsaurusAI/gemma-4-E2B-it-4bit · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Why this exists: Some mlx-community conversions of Gemma 4 have broken or zeroed-out vision/audio tower weights, producing models that appear functional for text but silently fail on image and audio inputs. This is a clean conversion from the original google/gemma-4-E2B-it with every multimodal weight tensor verified non-zero.
